hooks.command: $port = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome\User Data\DevToolsActivePort"; if (-not (Test-Path $port)) { $chrome = 'C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $chrome)) { $chrome = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe' }; Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList '--remote-debugging-port=9222'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3 }
